## Objective and scope

Instrument bounded checkpoint export on OASIS 11-to-12, OASIS 13-to-14, MMRR 11-to-12 and predeclared representative successes; use observed data only.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Save state at coarse/fine transitions and declared accepted/rejected updates with source, input, affine and configuration hashes; exact replay identifies checkpoint iteration and controller state.
2. Plot per-structure bidirectional Dice/surface distance against iteration together with trial loss, rebuilt loss, active support/variance weights, update size, deformation regularity, Jacobians and composed-map inverse errors.
3. Add a consistently defined audit score/region that permits across-iteration comparison, with lost coverage explicitly penalized/reported; it must not silently drop hard voxels.
4. Reproduce the known completed-but-anatomically-worse fine trajectories; label-based best-checkpoint selection is explicitly diagnostic and excluded from runtime inference.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/HalfFlowCcEngine.scala
- benchmarks/flashalign/runner/
- docs/benchmarks/

## Blocking prerequisites

- P01 (`bd-01M4X4DXPNC41BN15X9MBD7HGY`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
